name: Blekinge kustbana, mötesspår och hastighetshöjning
notes: Byggstart autumn 2026, complete December 2027. New passing siding at Bredåkra plus switch and track work along the 129 km Kristianstad–Karlskrona line.

name: E10, Morjärv–Västra Svartbyn, mötesfri väg (etapp 1)
notes: ~23.5 km in total. Only the Grannäs–Västra Svartbyn section has a schedule: byggstart autumn 2026, complete 2029. Morjärv–Grannäs has no timeline.

name: E16/väg 70, Borlänge–Djurås, mötesfri väg
notes: Three phases. Etapp 1 finished autumn 2023; etapp 2 paused and under cost review with completion expected autumn 2026; etapp 3 byggstart spring 2027. No whole-project completion year is published. Gagnef is derived from Djurås, not named on the page.

name: E20 förbi Mariestad
notes: Two phases: Hindsberg–Muggebo 2024–2027 and Muggebo–Tjos 2025–2029. The project page states 1 400 MSEK in 2013 price level; 2 252 MSEK is the plan's 2025-02 total.

name: E20 Götene–Mariestad
notes: 20 km to 2+2 motorway; byggstart 2025, complete autumn 2028. The project page states 1 150 MSEK in 2013 price level — nearly 13 years stale; 1 607 MSEK is the plan's 2025-02 total.

name: E22 Björketorp (Ronneby Ö)–Nättraby
notes: Byggstart clearance 24 April 2026; motorway conversion. The government release states no years or costs. A Trafikverket project page exists but was not fetched, so the release is the cited source.

name: E22, förbifart Söderköping
notes: Byggstart autumn 2026, opening summer 2030. All level crossings grade-separated.

name: E4/E20 Hallunda–Vårby, delen Fittja–Vårby, kapacitetsförstärkning
notes: Byggstart clearance 24 April 2026; widening to 4+4 lanes as a consequence of Förbifart Stockholm. The adjoining Hallunda–Fittja section (1 004 MSEK, plan phase 'Förberedelse för byggstart') is planned for construction 2031–2034 per its own project page, which was last updated 2023-03-20.

name: E4, förbifart Skellefteå
notes: Corridor 'Östra leden' chosen May 2025; road plan expected 2030, byggstart preliminarily 2031. The plan allocates 0 kr inside 2026–2037, so the 2 439 MSEK sits beyond the plan period.

name: E4 Förbifart Stockholm
notes: 21 km, over 18 km in tunnel, Kungens kurva–Häggvik. Häggvik–Hjulsta opens 2026, full completion 2030. The project page states 51,0–53,5 miljarder with 51,5 likely in 2021 price level; 58 076 MSEK is the plan's total object cost in 2025-02. The page names five kommuner but does not list them — the four given are derived from place names on the page.

name: E4, Kongberget–Gnarp, mötesfri väg
notes: Byggstart clearance from the government 24 April 2026; project page gives byggstart preliminarily 2029 and no completion year. ~22 km, 2+1, 110 km/h.

name: Järnvågen med överdäckning av E45
notes: Byggstart summer 2024, complete 2026. Plan footnote (3): 0 kr from the planning frame, presupposes full funding from other parties.

name: E45, Vattnäs–Trunna
notes: Road plan established 2025; byggstart earliest 2027, complete 2030. Rebuild to 2+1 with median barrier.

name: E65 Svedala–Börringe
notes: Road plan legally binding, government byggstart decision taken; byggstart planned 2027, no completion year published. ~5.4 km.

name: Västra stambanan, Göteborg–Alingsås, högre kapacitet hela sträckan
notes: Plan object JVA2201, phase 'Planering', 4 215 MSEK of 26 447 inside 2026–2037. No dedicated project page exists yet; the separate page 'Västra stambanan, Göteborg–Alingsås' covers a 2025–2027 renewal programme (Lerum station to four tracks, power supply, tunnels), not this investment.

name: Ny järnväg Göteborg–Borås och bibana Mölnlycke
notes: Government approval 11 June 2026; byggstart 2029–2031 and about ten years' construction, but no opening year is published, so open_year is blank. Page states ~59 bn in 2025 price level, which matches the plan. Future stations at Bollebygd and Landvetter södra are mentioned but not funded.

name: Göteborg, spårväg och citybuss Brunnsbo–Linné via Lindholmen
notes: 2039 is the opening of the Lindholmsförbindelsen tunnel (byggstart 2031, preparatory works 2027); the city's own figure for that tunnel alone is 4 240 MSEK in 2014 price level. The 7 233 MSEK is plan object SVF1806 for the wider Brunnsbo–Linné programme. The Frihamnen–Lindholmen tram section opened December 2025.

name: Godsstråket genom Bergslagen, dubbelspår Hallsberg–Degerön
notes: Five of six sub-stretches finished; the last, Hallsberg–Stenkumla, runs 2023–2031. Page states 10,9 miljarder in 2025 års prisnivå (month not given, hence price_base '2025'). The adopted plan carries a narrower object 'Godsstråket Hallsberg–Åsbro, dubbelspår' at 6 191 MSEK in 2025-02. Only Hallsberg kommun is named on the page.

name: Hässleholm–Lund, två nya spår
notes: Byggstart from 2034; the page states traffic start is 'svårbedömd' because alignment, staging and method are undecided, so open_year is blank. The page's own figure is 28 miljarder in 2021 price level. A sub-project 'Lund, fyra spår' (Klostergården–Stångby) is in early consultation.

name: Högdalsdepån, utbyggnad
notes: Depot expansion plus a 2.5 km new tunnel to the Farsta branch; enabling works for the metro extensions rather than a passenger line.

name: Laxå–Arvika, Karlstad C
notes: New tracks, an island platform, the Trädgårdslänken footbridge and the Vikenpassagen tunnel. Byggstart February 2023, Vikenpassagen inaugurated 4 May 2026; Trafikverket's part is finished.

name: Kiruna, ny järnvägsstation
notes: Railway plan submitted for approval; byggstart 'ej bestämd'. Moves the temporary station to the new centre. Plan footnote (3): the object gets 0 kr from the planning frame and presupposes full funding from other parties.

name: Malmöpendeln Lommabanan, etapp 2
notes: Railway plan established, contractor procurement under way; full line closure summer 2027 and opening December 2027. Etapp 1 (stations Lomma and Furulund) opened December 2020.

name: Malmö C, fler plattformsspår
notes: Byggstart decision 24 April 2026. Two new platform tracks ahead of the Fehmarn Belt opening; byggstart brought forward to 2027 with completion 2029 per secondary reporting — the government release itself gives no years, so the 2029 is medium confidence.

name: Norrbotniabanan, Dåva–Skellefteå
notes: Opening 2036 per the project page. The station list is Trafikverket's for the whole line, split between the stretches by geography — see caveat 3 below.

name: Norrbotniabanan, Skellefteå–Luleå, ny järnväg
notes: Still in planering in the adopted plan, with 14 353 of the 37 488 MSEK falling inside 2026–2037. The whole Norrbotniabanan is stated at 62 bn SEK in 2025 price level, which the three plan objects sum to.

name: Norrbotniabanan, Umeå–Dåva
notes: First stretch; page states 'År 2026 kan tågen köra mellan Umeå och Dåva'. Earlier plans had this section opening in 2024.

name: Olskroken planskildhet
notes: Grade separation handed over to Trafikverket's maintenance organisation; the Västlänken tracks through it go live in 2026. Source page last updated 2022-08-02, so both the year and the ~4 bn SEK are stale — low confidence.

name: Ostkustbanan, Sundsvall C–Dingersjö, dubbelspårsutbyggnad
notes: 12.5 km. Budget is the sum of two plan objects (Sundsvall C–Kubikenborg 877 + Kubikenborg–Dingersjö 4 065). The project page says 'cirka 4,5 miljarder' without a price base. Byggstart 2025 and 2028 respectively, both complete 2032.

name: Ostkustbanan, fyra spår Uppsala–länsgränsen Uppsala/Stockholm
notes: ~23 km of two extra tracks, opening 2034 for both sub-stretches. Byggstart earliest late 2026 (Söder Bergsbrunna–Uppsala C) and earliest 2028 (länsgränsen–Söder Bergsbrunna).

name: Ostkustbanan, Gävle–Kringlan (Axmartavlan), nytt dubbelspår
notes: Classified 'Förberedelse för byggstart' in the plan, but the project page says an analysis is running through autumn 2026 and gives no byggstart or opening year. Has ~39 MSEK EU co-funding for system documentation.

name: Ostlänken, nytt dubbelspår Järna–Linköping
notes: ~150 km for 250 km/h; construction 2024–2034, traffic 2035. Plan cost excluding co-financing is 102 825 MSEK, matching the project page's '102,8 miljarder i 2025 års prisnivå'; 106 226 adds co-financing. Footnote (7) in the plan records that the pre-decision cost ceiling was 91,4 bn in price base 2021-02.

name: Östlig förbindelse, utredning
notes: Plan object VOR2606. The 1 000 MSEK funds the study only, not construction — do not present it as a project budget. No kommuner are named in the plan row.

name: Roslagsbanan till City, förlängning och nya stationer
notes: ~4 km tunnel from Universitetet via Odenplan to T-Centralen. Page gives preparatory works from 2028 and main works from 2030 but states no traffic start, so open_year is blank.

name: Spårväg Lund C–ESS
notes: Opened December 2020, 5.5 km double track. lund.se states the municipality's own investment as ~890 MSEK with 373 MSEK state funding, price base not given; the plan's total object cost is 1 066 MSEK in 2025-02.

name: Spårväg syd, Flemingsberg–Skärholmen (etapp 1)
notes: Etapp 1 is ~10 km with eight stations, whose names the page does not publish. Full line Flemingsberg–Älvsjö is ~17 km. No byggstart or trafikstart on the page.

name: Sundsvall resecentrum, tillgänglighet och plattformar
notes: New platforms and a glazed overbridge; construction 2023–2031, footbridge 2028–2030.

name: Sydostlänken (Älmhult–Olofström–Karlshamn), elektrifiering och ny bana
notes: Government cleared preparation for byggstart 4 July 2024; byggstart planned 2029. 41 km electrification Älmhult–Olofström plus 17 km of new track to Blekinge kustbana. No opening year published.

name: Tunnelbanans blå linje, Akalla–Barkarby
notes: Page states traffic start December 2027; 4 km extension from Akalla. No per-line budget is published — the 55.5 bn SEK (2016 price level) figure covers all of nya tunnelbanan.

name: Tunnelbanans gula linje, Fridhemsplan–Älvsjö
notes: Project page gives construction start 2026 and roughly nine years' build but no opening year, so open_year is left blank. Budget is plan object SVF1801 'Älvsjö-Fridhemsplan, tunnelbana och nya stationer'. Driverless trains and platform screen doors.

name: Tunnelbanans blå linje, Kungsträdgården–Nacka
notes: Nacka and Söderort share one project page and one stated traffic start of 2030; station Sofia serves both branches.

name: Tunnelbanans gröna linje, Odenplan–Arenastaden
notes: Page states traffic start 2028; which southern branch the line will run to (Gullmarsplan, Farsta or Skarpnäck) is not yet decided.

name: Tunnelbanans blå linje till Söderort
notes: Blue line takes over the Hagsätra branch; Gullmarsplan gets a new platform beneath the green line.

name: E4/Lv 259 Tvärförbindelse Södertörn
notes: Byggstart decision 28 April 2026; road plan legally binding January 2024. ~20 km Kungens kurva–Flemingsberg–Jordbro, about a quarter in tunnel. No opening year published. 19 502 of the 23 582 MSEK falls inside 2026–2037.

name: Uppsala spårväg
notes: Phase 2 (genomförande) began 2 July 2026. The 2029 opening is what the overview page states, but the page carries no update date and the dedicated timeline page 404s — treat the year as soft. The Ultunalänken component has no published completion date.

name: Vänersjöfarten, nya slussar i Trollhätte kanal/Göta älv
notes: Byggstart by site: Lilla Edet Q2 2027, Trollhättan Q2 2028, Vänersborg Q2 2029; all locks in operation 2032–2034. The project page states 6,1 miljarder in 2021 price level and explicitly says the current-price figure is not yet confirmed.

name: Varberg, dubbelspår (tunnel) inklusive resecentrum
notes: Opened 14 July 2025; 9 km double track with a 3 km city-centre tunnel and a relocated station. The project page states 8,6 miljarder in 2021 price level; 9 916 MSEK is the plan's total object cost in 2025-02 including co-financing from Varbergs kommun, Region Halland and Jernhusen.

name: Värmlandsbanan, Karlstad–Kil, dubbelspår
notes: Plan object JVA2219, phase 'Planering', fully inside the plan period. No dedicated project page found.

name: Västlänken
notes: Four new underground tracks at Göteborg C open 13 December 2026 as a terminus; Haga and Korsvägen open with the full tunnel, likely 2030 within a 2029–2032 span. Budget deliberately left blank — the Trafikverket page (last updated 2023-09-05) states two different 2009-price figures, see the disagreement section.
